panels.description: 黑色制造流程和蓝色反馈线

facts.statement: Black arrows indicate the manufacturing flow; blue arrows indicate information feedback.
Raw materials and manufactured components both enter storage.
facts.location: 上方两个框的黑色箭头指向storage

facts.statement: The main sequence is storage, production planning, assembly, inspection, testing, packaging, despatch and sales.
facts.location: 左列自上而下黑色箭头

facts.statement: Product research leads to design, which leads to production planning.
facts.location: 右上product research向下至design，再向左至production planning

facts.statement: Production planning sends information feedback to storage.
facts.location: production planning左边蓝线从约y249向左上至storage箭头；与下方sales长线分离

facts.statement: Testing sends information feedback to design.
facts.location: testing右端蓝线沿约y426向右再向上至design底边

facts.statement: Sales sends feedback to production planning and to market research.
facts.location: sales底部左侧长蓝线指向planning；右侧长蓝线指向market research

facts.statement: Market research sends feedback to design, packaging and advertising.
facts.location: market research顶边蓝线向design；左边沿约y445后向下左至packaging；下边箭头向advertising

keyFeatures.description: 主生产链从储存到销售
产品研究与设计接入生产计划
生产主链之外有多个反馈支路

uncertainties: 交叉折线不表示连接；不得额外补出testing→packaging、sales→storage或advertising→market research。
